title: Open Earth Model Comparison with Claude Opus
content: An open-source model called Open Earth matched Claude Opus on coding tasks. It is available for download and has several advantages: it is 5 GB in size, does not require an API key or rate limits, and the weights are user-owned. Open Earth scored 77.5 on Terminal Bench and 82.4 on SweetBench, outperforming Claude Opus 4.7 which scored 70.3 and 80.8 respectively. Open Earth also outperformed other leading open models like MiniMax and DeepSeek across various benchmarks. Open Earth is available in four sizes: 9 billion, 31 billion, a mixture of experts, and a 397 billion flagship model. All models use the same training recipe.
